summary: FS page, recreation.gov facility/rates/per-site catalog and imagery read. $22 + $5 vehicle confirmed; 24 sites (4 tent), max 30 ft (two at 25); vault toilets; drinking water contradictory on the FS page -> unknown; season 05-21..09-25 (rec.gov 2027); reservable, one walk-up site. Phone '' -> 530-587-3558. Riverview kept after a hard look: the river is ~15-22 m wide and the nearest RV site is ~50-55 m away through continuous canopy.
flags: WATERFRONT 'riverview' KEPT after a hard check. Imagery: continuous lodgepole/fir canopy over every loop; the Truckee River here is ~15-22 m wide, which is creek-size under the 30 m rule, so an on-water value would be creekside at most. The nearest RV site, 011 (39.26010,-120.20947), is ~50-55 m from the water through the trees; 008 (39.25963,-120.20956) ~80 m; the southern loop (14-24) 60-110 m. Only tent-only sites 009/010 (~35 m) come close. FS 'situated on the banks above the Truckee River ... all are a short walking distance to the river' does not put any RV pad at the water. If the canopy is judged to block any sightline, 'not waterfront' is the next step down; not upgraded.
